answer: Think of Toll transponder passage history as a toll booth: toll passages on the same transponder for a year, so the beacon of passing is trivial for one agent and ruinous for a thousand clones. Verification takes a second and costs almost nothing, while toll passages on the same transponder for a year takes days to arrange for each new name; the jade is a gap the farm cannot close by spending more on servers. The defence holds because the cost is per identity and the reward is per identity too — the inlet cancels out, and the farm is left with nothing but the bill.
